name: shuohao-skills
tagline: A skill collection for AI coding agents — works with both Claude Code and Codex
description: shuohao-skills is a collection of skills for AI coding agents that run in both Claude Code and Codex. The flagship skill, novel-characters, turns a novel into a character bible: character profiles, cartoon-design prompts, voice-prompt text, and turnaround sheets. The project is bilingual (Chinese and English) and demonstrates a practical, cross-agent approach to packing domain knowledge into reusable agent skills.
highlights: Skills that run on both Claude Code and Codex without modification
novel-characters converts a novel into a complete character bible with art and voice prompts
Bilingual (CN/EN) documentation for a global audience
Active community with 621 stars and growing
curatorNote: Cross-agent compatibility is the sleeper feature here — most skill repos lock into one agent, while this one runs on both Claude Code and Codex, making the novel-to-character-bible workflow genuinely portable.
